thread:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT detected: Elevated generation tail latency in EU dedicated pool (eu-dedicated-01). Severity: P2. Paging on-call.
Emily H: I'm on call — taking the page. Observed 95th p95 jumps ~700ms for long-seq requests. Rolling fallback to fastgen-small is currently enabled.
Raj K: Thanks Emily. Can you confirm impact footprint? EU dedicated customers only or are hosted API requests affected too?
Emily H: Looks isolated to dedicated GPU pool eu-dedicated-01. Hosted API routing has been diverting to other regions; small percentage saw latency spikes during the window.
Lena S: Ops note — early signs point to degraded NVLink interconnect after a maintenance job. I'm running `nvidia-smi topo -m` and checking driver logs.
Tyler M: For statusboard copy: we should be explicit about who is impacted and what we're doing. Draft below — pls review.
customer-comms: Draft suggestion:
```
We are investigating elevated generation latency impacting customers using the EU dedicated inference pool (eu-dedicated-01). Some long-sequence text generation requests may see slower responses. Our engineers have activated a regional fallback and are working on restoring normal performance. No data loss is expected. Next update in 15 minutes.
```
Emily H: I like that. Add: "If you use pinned capacity in eu-dedicated-01, you may see throttling while we rebalance." Also include a link to customer-facing KB about pinned capacity behavior.
customer-comms: Incorporated — new draft:
```
We are investigating elevated generation latency impacting customers with reserved or pinned capacity in the EU dedicated pool (eu-dedicated-01). Long-sequence generation requests may experience slower responses. Engineers have enabled a temporary model fallback and are rebalancing workloads across nearby capacity to reduce impact. No data loss is expected. We will post updates every 15 minutes until resolved. If you have critical traffic, contact support and include your account id.
```
Raj K: Ops: can we commit to that 15-minute cadence? If remediation takes longer, we'll shift to 30m. Also confirm who will hit publish on the statusboard.
ops-lead: I can publish the initial note to the statusboard once we have one edit pass from customer-comms. I'll also tag infra for driver rollback if Lena's findings confirm the NVLink issue.
Lena S: Confirmed: two nodes show degraded link metrics and kernel logs show recurring nvlink errors since the last driver rollout. Escalating to infra for rollback. Taking node eu-node-07 out of rotation.
Emily H: Publishing plan: ops-lead publishes initial message now, I will post the first technical update at +15, and customer-comms will push the wording to the public page. If we do an infra rollback, we'll publish a secondary update noting the action and a projected time-to-recover estimate.
customer-comms: I'll post the initial statusboard entry as soon as ops-lead gives the go. Also drafting a short email digest for affected enterprise customers with suggested mitigation steps (pin to alternate region, temporarily lower max tokens).
Tyler M: Quick note on tone — avoid "outage" unless SLA confirmed. Use "degraded performance" and be prescriptive about mitigations.
ops-lead: Go for publish. Pasting the final copy I'm about to post:
```
Status: Investigating — Elevated generation latency in EU dedicated pool (eu-dedicated-01).
Impact: Customers with reserved/pinned capacity in eu-dedicated-01 may experience slower long-sequence responses. Hosted API routing largely unaffected.
Mitigation: Temporary model fallback activated; affected nodes being removed and rebalanced. No data loss expected.
Next update: in 15 minutes or upon significant change.
```
ops-lead: Published to statusboard. Link: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1738502468
Emily H: Thanks. I'll gather perf graphs and post a technical update in ~13 minutes. Assigning follow-ups: infra to validate rollback (Lena), oncall to monitor client errors and token rate (Emily), comms to prepare customer email (customer-comms).
Raj K: Also ensure the internal ops runbook section is noted: include incident id 1738502468 and the rollback play. We'll want a short postmortem pointer in the final resolved notice.
customer-comms: Noted. Drafting enterprise email now; will circulate for a quick legal check before sending. Will include steps to temporarily redirect traffic to other regions.
Lena S: Infra confirmed rollback queued. Timeline estimate: 12-18 minutes to rollback drivers and bring eu-node-07 back into rotation after validation.
Emily H: Update: after removing eu-node-07, p95 dropped to ~180ms. Some improvement but still above baseline. I'll post full metrics at the +15 update.
ops-lead: If metrics keep improving, we plan to resolve the statusboard entry with a concise root cause and actions taken once all nodes validated. Keep this thread for publish coordination and final resolved copy.
customer-comms: Preparing resolved copy template now so we can quickly publish when ops gives final ok.
Emily H: Thanks team. I'll send the +15 update in this thread shortly.
